import os, re, sys

doc_dir = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'unpacked'
xml_path = os.path.join(doc_dir, 'word', 'document.xml')
with open(xml_path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find all paragraphs and their styles / text
para_re = re.compile(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', re.S)
styles_xml = os.path.join(doc_dir, 'word', 'styles.xml')
style_names = {}
if os.path.exists(styles_xml):
    with open(styles_xml, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        s = f.read()
    for m in re.finditer(r'<w:style [^>]*w:styleId="([^"]+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</w:style>', s, re.S):
        sid, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        nm = re.search(r'<w:name w:val="([^"]+)"', body)
        style_names[sid] = nm.group(1) if nm else sid

for i, p in enumerate(para_re.findall(content)):
    st = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    sid = st.group(1) if st else '(none)'
    texts = ''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p))
    deltexts = ''.join(re.findall(r'<w:delText[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:delText>', p))
    if texts.strip() or deltexts.strip():
        print(f"P{i:03d} style={sid}({style_names.get(sid,'?')}) text={texts!r} del={deltexts!r}")

import os, re, sys

doc_dir = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'unpacked'
xml_path = os.path.join(doc_dir, 'word', 'document.xml')
with open(xml_path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

headlines = ['EXECUTIVE SUMMARY', 'FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS', 'REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT',
             'KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS', 'OPERATING EXPENSES', 'Q1 2025 OUTLOOK', 'RISK FACTORS']

for h in headlines:
    idx = content.find(f'>{h}<')
    if idx == -1:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {h}")
        continue
    start = content.rfind('<w:p ', 0, idx)
    if start == -1:
        start = content.rfind('<w:p>', 0, idx)
    end = content.find('</w:p>', idx) + len('</w:p>')
    print(f"===== {h} =====")
    print(content[start:end])
    print()

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = [
    'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY',
    'FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS',
    'REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT',
    'KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS',
    'OPERATING EXPENSES',
    'Q1 2025 OUTLOOK',
    'RISK FACTORS',
]

doc = Document('unpacked', rsid='A0FB77FB')
editor = doc['word/document.xml']

updated = 0
for text in HEADLINES:
    node = editor.get_node(tag='w:r', contains=text)
    rprs = node.getElementsByTagName('w:rPr')
    if not rprs:
        print(f'SKIP (no rPr): {text}')
        continue
    rpr = rprs[0]
    if rpr.getElementsByTagName('w:u'):
        print(f'ALREADY UNDERLINED: {text}')
        continue
    u = rpr.ownerDocument.createElement('w:u')
    u.setAttribute('w:val', 'single')
    szcs = rpr.getElementsByTagName('w:sz-cs')
    if szcs:
        rpr.insertBefore(u, szcs[0].nextSibling)
    else:
        rpr.appendChild(u)
    updated += 1
    print(f'UNDERLINED: {text}')

doc.save()
print(f'Total headlines underlined: {updated}')

import os, re, sys
import xml.dom.minidom

doc_dir = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'unpacked'
xml_path = os.path.join(doc_dir, 'word', 'document.xml')
with open(xml_path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

HEADLINES = [
    'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY',
    'FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS',
    'REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT',
    'KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS',
    'OPERATING EXPENSES',
    'Q1 2025 OUTLOOK',
    'RISK FACTORS',
]

updated = 0
for text in HEADLINES:
    m = re.search(r'<w:t[^>]*>' + re.escape(text) + r'</w:t>', content)
    if not m:
        print(f'NOT FOUND: {text}')
        continue
    rpr_start = content.rfind('<w:rPr>', 0, m.start())
    if rpr_start == -1:
        print(f'NO rPr BEFORE: {text}')
        continue
    rpr_end = content.find('</w:rPr>', rpr_start)
    if rpr_end == -1 or rpr_end > m.start():
        print(f'BAD rPr RANGE: {text}')
        continue
    block = content[rpr_start:rpr_end]
    if re.search(r'<w:u\s', block):
        print(f'ALREADY UNDERLINED: {text}')
        continue
    content = content[:rpr_end] + '<w:u w:val="single"/>' + content[rpr_end:]
    updated += 1
    print(f'UNDERLINED: {text}')

with open(xml_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)

# Validate well-formedness
xml.dom.minidom.parseString(content.encode('utf-8'))

# Verify: each headline run now carries w:u single
with open(xml_path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    check = f.read()
ok = 0
for text in HEADLINES:
    m = re.search(r'<w:t[^>]*>' + re.escape(text) + r'</w:t>', check)
    if not m:
        print(f'VERIFY MISSING: {text}')
        continue
    rpr_start = check.rfind('<w:rPr>', 0, m.start())
    rpr_end = check.find('</w:rPr>', rpr_start)
    if re.search(r'<w:u w:val="single"/>', check[rpr_start:rpr_end]):
        ok += 1
    else:
        print(f'VERIFY FAIL: {text}')
print(f'Headlines underlined: {updated}; verified: {ok}/{len(HEADLINES)}')
